title: Carbohydrate-based alternatives to traditional synthetic plastic microbeads: a critical review
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00364K, Critical Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Amy McMackin, Sébastien Cardinal
Carbohydrate-based biopolymers from animals, plants, algae, and microbes used in microbead production are compared to their petrochemical and synthetic bioplastic counterparts. The analysis focuses on sustainability, versatility, and performance.
